Now, follow orders and get in the ship.|Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker, on the regrouping battle droids|}} The '''First Battle of Felucia''' took place for control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] seized Felucia with the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and the latter's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], were dispatched to lead a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] detachment of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to maintain the Republic's foothold on the world. However, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and their forces were soon overwhelmed by the deeply entrenched Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|troops]], and Republic reinforcements were sent to extract the Jedi and the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] from the contested world. While [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]] oversaw the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Hunter Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Hunter Squadron]] and several [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] in their assault on the large Separatist [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] surrounding Felucia, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] took a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] with [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] escorts to rescue the Jedi and clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] on the embattled surface. Although Kenobi, Skywalker, Tano, and the remainder of their battle group were able to evacuate from the planet with Koon's team, the Republic's failure to hold Felucia hampered the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army's]] efforts in the [[Thanium sector/Legends|entire sector]]. ==Prelude== {{Quote|Grievous. Attacked Felucia he has. Heavy are the losses. In need of your leadership the clones are.|Yoda, to Anakin Skywalker|}} From the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|beginning]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]{{TCWA|Galactic Forces}} in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] established a foothold of strength on the forested [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Becoming a contested site between the Confederacy and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Felucia's state of contention escalated later the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], and the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] initiated an assault on the jungle world to conquer it for the Confederacy. ==The battle== ===Separatist advances=== {{Quote|Ahsoka, where are you? Ahsoka, what is your location?''"
"''About six clicks ''[sic]'' east, Master. We've engaged the enemy and we've got them on the run.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Ahsoka Tano|}} [[File:BattleofFeluciaTCWDB.png|thumb|left|250px|Clone troopers defend their position on Felucia from surrounding battle droids.]] With Grievous, Ventress, and their [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] dealing heavy losses on Felucia, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] dispatched [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and the latter's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], with a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] detachment of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to defend the world. After the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and their [[Troop/Legends|troops]] had arrived, however, the Separatists—determined to gain control of the Outer Rim world—deployed their forces in overwhelming numbers. With a Separatist [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]] and numerous [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockading]] Felucian [[Realspace/Legends|space]], the Jedi and [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] were trapped on the beleaguered planet. A large army of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]], [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2]], and [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]] converged upon the Republic's main position—a jungle clearing where the Jedi, [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]], and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] had established cover for the main body of clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] by surrounding them with [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]]. Skywalker and Kenobi headed the defense of the main camp against the battle [[Droid/Legends|droid]] army, using their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] to deflect the droids' [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire while the clones returned [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] rounds back into the droid lines. Tano, meanwhile, was assigned to take a pair of AT-TE [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] and a [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|Juggernaut tank]] on a patrol of the dense jungle, but when she encountered groups of battle droids and [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] just six [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] east of the clones' main position, she chose not to return to the besieged clone encampment in the clearing as scheduled. Instead, she led her patrol against the droids, deflecting laser shots with her [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|lightsaber]] from atop her Juggernaut, while her [[Clone gunner/Legends|clone tank gunners]] concentrated the AT-TE walkers' fire on the droids. As the Republic forces desperately tried to hold the line against the Separatists, Ventress landed with a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] and an army of Separatist droids at a canyon on the planet. A [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] CC-2224, nicknamed "Cody," proceeded to secure the canyon to safeguard the Republic's last foothold on the world, and their battle group utilized tower-mounted blaster turrets to intercept the enemy troops. When her droids and Armored Assault [[Tank/Legends|Tanks]] were unable to claim the clones' position, Ventress sent out droid-[[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]] to cut through the Republic lines. Despite deploying all of her forces, Ventress initially failed to defeat the Republic detachment, but she did not relent and began a counterattack that pushed Felucia's defenses to their limits. Cody and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] then moved to secure a strategic canyon that led straight to the Separatists' base, a tactic that would force the Separatists to reinforce their own defenses with troops from the front lines. After her droids had begun to assault the clone forces, Ventress executed a surprise attack, clearing a path through the Republic's fortifications and sending [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] and other troops through the breach before the clones could attend to the weak point. Although Cody, the Jedi Knight, and their men emerged victorious at the canyon and cleared a path to the droids' base, Ventress remained determined to capture Felucia. ===The Republic in retreat=== {{Quote|Come on, grunts! We are leaving!|Rex orders his men onto the evacuation gunships|}} [[File:BlockadeofFelucia.png|thumb|right|250px|The Republic fleet battles the Separatist blockade of Felucia.]] As the Separatists continued to whittle away at the Republic defenses, Republic reinforcements arrived to rescue the Jedi and clones who had been trapped on the planet's embattled surface. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and his [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion's]] [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] were assigned to provide support for the withdrawal, bringing a three-[[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], including the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Negotiator/Legends|''Negotiator'']]. While the trio of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] exchanged heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire with the Separatist blockade under the supervision of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]], nicknamed "Wolffe," Koon—flying his [[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Delta-7B interceptor]]—led several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] and an escorting [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] to evacuate the troops on Felucia. Tasked with breaching the enemy blockade to make way for Koon's rescue [[Starship/Legends|ships]], the Jedi Knight who had commanded the canyon battle against Ventress led, from a [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B interceptor]], the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] of [[Hunter Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Hunter Squadron]] in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combating]] the Separatists' [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] and [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]]. During the battle, the Jedi Knight and Hunter Squadron were able to destroy a ''Munificent''-class [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] that was blocking the Republic ships with its heavy fire. Once the Jedi Knight and Hunter Squadron had cleared a path through more Vulture [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]], Koon—leading the evacuation team of LAAT/i [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] and their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] escorts alongside another Delta-7B interceptor—had his fighters form up around the gunships and moved to challenge the now-weakened Separatist blockade. Ordering his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]], clone pilot "[[Warthog/Legends|Warthog]]," to protect the gunships, Koon cut through an approaching squadron of Vulture droids, securing safe passage for the rest of the Republic craft. Though the Republic evacuation ships made it past the blockade and through the first wave of droids, they were pursued into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Felucia by numerous droid starfighters. Wolffe, meanwhile, had one of the Republic cruisers concentrate its firepower on one of the Confederate frigates. With the blockade breached, Koon dispatched his aerial forces to support the Republic ground troops who had been pinned down in the Felucian jungles. One of the Republic's LAAT/i gunships was tasked with battling through the deeply entrenched and well-supplied Separatist droids to destroy a ''Munificent''-class [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]]. The gunship fought through numerous [[Rocket pack/Legends|rocket pack]]–equipped [[B2-RP battle droid/Legends|B2-RP battle droids]], [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP droid gunships]], and [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter/Legends|''Rogue''-class starfighters]]—as well as other droid fighters, Armored Assault Tanks, and [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 ''Persuader''-class tanks]]—before encountering a Separatist [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|laser field]] that had been erected on some of the battlefield's debris. After maneuvering through the laser web and cutting through more droids, the gunship faced off with the enemy frigate and managed to destroy it. Koon and his Jedi Knight wingmate led their extraction team to the evacuation site, battling through a large number of droid starfighters in addition to [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], [[Octuptarra magna tri-droid/Legends|octuptarra magna tri-droids]], Armored Assault Tanks, and other droid troops along the way. Elsewhere, Kenobi's men continued to lose ground to the droid forces, and there was soon nowhere for them to fall back to. The Separatists then began a push on clone forces to the east of Kenobi's position, requiring an immediate evacuation there, but Koon, the Jedi Knight, and their forces arrived just in [[Time/Legends|time]] to thwart the droids from overtaking the clones' encampment. After picking up the clones at that base, Koon and his team headed west to the main evacuation site. As he neared Kenobi's position with Koon and their team, Warthog came under attack by two pursuant Vulture droids, and Koon turned around to assist the clone pilot. Though Koon managed to destroy one of the droids, the other hit the debris of the disabled fighter and spun out of control toward the Republic forces below in the clearing. The careening Vulture droid crashed into an AT-TE walker, and Skywalker and Kenobi jumped out of the way just in time to avoid the collision. Realizing that the gunships had broken through the blockade, the Jedi Generals prepared their troops for the evacuation. Once the LAAT/i gunships had landed, Cody and CT-7567, nicknamed "Rex," led their men into the ships while returning the droids' fire. [[File:Rescue_on_Felucia.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The evacuation gunships fly in to rescue Tano and her tank patrol from the droid army.]] With the evacuation underway, Kenobi contacted Tano and ordered her to retreat, but the Padawan—who was overdue at the main evacuation site, having continued her fight against the battle droids just east of Kenobi's position—had already broken through the Separatist defenses and refused to abandon her battle. As the gunships lifted off with the main Republic force aboard, Kenobi restated his order to Tano, who remained determined to defeat the retreating droids. The Padawan and her patrol continued to push back the Separatists, but as Skywalker and Kenobi approached Tano's troops, they noticed that battle droid reinforcements were regrouping to counterattack her patrol. Skywalker had the LAAT/i gunships land directly between the two factions, blocking the Republic patrol's fire and forcing Tano's troops to halt their advance. Unable to see the droid reinforcements from her vantage point, Tano again objected to abandoning the fight, but she finally relented when Skywalker ordered her onto his [[Plo's Bros/Legends|gunship]]. The clones returned fire at the advancing droid lines but were unable to fully stop them, and Tano realized her mistake as she witnessed the destruction of her abandoned tanks at the hands of the battle droids. While the Republic evacuation ships began to pull the overwhelmed clone forces out of the battle zone, Ventress unleashed the "full fury" of her droid armies against the Republic forces, forcing the few remaining pockets of Republic resistance to fortify their positions for their final stand against the Separatists while they waited to be evacuated. Cody and the Jedi Knight returned to their base, but, as their forces were scheduled to be the last for evacuation, the detachment prepared to defend their position from Ventress, who was planning a final push on their encampment. The Separatists soon arrived and began their assault on the Republic base, utilizing tough [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]] to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] the droids to the battlefield. With the battle in full force, Ventress began to advance her forces forward under the protection of a mobile [[super tank shield generator]], making it extremely difficult for the Republic's blaster turrets to prevent the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielded]] droids from compromising their position. However, Republic reinforcements soon arrived at the base in the form of a [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeder]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of clone troopers, who attacked the droids and tossed [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade/Legends|EMP grenades]] as they passed. With the added firepower of the [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeders]], the clone detachment was able to eliminate the mobile [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] and the battle droids that it was protecting. Having won their part of the battle, Cody, the Jedi Knight, and their forces evacuated from Felucia aboard the ''Negotiator''. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|The setback at Felucia has affected our efforts in the whole sector. It'll take weeks before we can…|Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} [[File:CloneLieutenantGalleOnFelucia.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Republic forces return to secure Felucia late in the war as part of the Outer Rim Sieges.]] The Republic's failure to hold Felucia impeded the Grand Army's efforts in the entire [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium sector]], of which Felucia was a part. Back at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Kenobi, Skywalker, and Tano debriefed with the Jedi High Council on the First Battle of Felucia, as it came to be known, and Tano was put to a hearing before the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] for her failure to obey her orders during the evacuation from the planet. Jedi Masters [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] assigned the Padawan to guard duty in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] with [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi Librarian]] [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]] so that Tano could reflect on her actions away from the war zone. However, the Jedi were soon forced to defend their Temple against the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], who had been hired by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|steal]] a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the Archives. Although the Confederacy made a stronghold of Felucia as the Clone Wars persisted, the world remained a site of contention.{{TCW|Padawan Lost}}{{SW|url=news/chronicling-the-clone-wars-7|text=Chronicling ''The Clone Wars'' #7|int=Chronicling The Clone Wars}} The native [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] [[Farm/Legends|farmers]] tried to preserve their neutral status, while the Separatists further hampered the Republic's efforts in the area by [[Destruction of the Felucia medical station/Legends|destroying]] a [[Felucia medical station/Legends|medical station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}} In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],{{TCWdates|321}} Skywalker, Tano, and Plo Koon returned to Felucia to [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|overrun]] a [[Separatist outpost (Felucia)/Legends|Separatist outpost]]. The world again became a battlefield{{Film|III}} in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], when the Republic launched a [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|campaign]] to secure the strategic planet during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|[Yoda's line from the Comic-Con script reading] was meant as an ''[sic]'' lead-in to the action that begins 'Holocron Heist,' the second season premiere of ''The Clone Wars'', written by Paul Dini and directed by Justin Ridge. In the episode, we see Anakin, Ahsoka, Obi-Wan and Plo Koon in action against the droid forces amid the colorful jungles of the planet.|StarWars.com's Databank entry for Felucia|}} [[File:Battle_of_Felucia_art.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Concept art of the "Holocron Heist" battle]] The First Battle of Felucia was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series and was the setting for the opening act of "[[Holocron Heist]]," the [[October 2]], [[2009]] premiere of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]]. Prior to its debut, the battle was first pictured in concept art that was published in the [[July]] 2009 ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'',''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' and it was mentioned in a live script reading with the television series' main voice cast that was featured later that year at the [[Wikipedia:San Diego Comic-Con International|Comic-Con International convention]], with a script penned by Series Director [[Dave Filoni]]. The battle was finally confirmed in [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for the planet Felucia. In [[2010]], the battle was prominently featured in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' video game]], which used the battle as a setting in its "Republic Defender" and "Starfighter" mini-games, and that same year, it was also featured in StarWars.com's online ''[[Air Strike]]'' [[Star Wars video games|computer game]]. The [[2012]] publication ''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]'' gave the battle its official name, the "First Battle of Felucia." The [[2011]] [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] episode "[[Padawan Lost]]" featured another Battle of Felucia, occurring prior to the engagement of the Outer Rim Sieges. Although it was stated to have been an "unending battle"—implying that it was a simple continuation of the battle featured in "Holocron Heist"—no direct connection was confirmed. When Felucia received an entry in the StarWars.com [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]] in 2012, the battle from "Padawan Lost" was confirmed to have been a separate engagement, occurring after the First Battle of Felucia. [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 68|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 68]] incorrectly states that Ahsoka Tano lost both soldiers and equipment when she refused to retreat,{{FactFile2014|68|AHS 5-10|Ahsoka Tano}} whereas "Holocron Heist" only depicted her losing her equipment and vehicles, not any of her men.
